issue.title: [Bug]: Nightly CI failed - tests/e2e/online_serving/test_qwen3_omni_expansion.py::test_text_audio_to_text_audio_002[batch_token_2048] - AssertionError: The audio content is not same as the text (similarity 0.6675 < 0.8)
issue.body:
### Your current environment
The output of python collect_env.py ```text Nightly CI (Buildkite vllm/vllm-omni #20145, scheduled nightly build) Branch: release/v0.34.0 Queue: mithril-h100-pool, 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, node inf-4x8h100-2-2 ```
### Your code version
The commit id or version of vllm ```text 0.34.0 ```
The commit id or version of vllm-omni ```text 1194d6ba2096459f8d96af06fbfb765b14e01cac ```
### 🐛 Describe the bug **Buildkite build:** https://buildkite.com/vllm/vllm-omni/builds/20145 **Buildkite step:** [Omni · Function Test with H100 · 2-GPU](https://buildkite.com/vllm/vllm-omni/builds/20145#01a1ee1d-fa96-4bc2-a325-5d4f45ffa6ef) **Failure kind:** pytest FAILED **Test node:** `tests/e2e/online_serving/test_qwen3_omni_expansion.py::test_text_audio_to_text_audio_002[batch_token_2048]` **Log reason:** AssertionError: The audio content is not same as the text (tests/helpers/assertions.py:1015). Cosine similarity of the Whisper transcript vs the model's text was 0.6675 on the last request; threshold is 0.8. **Analysis:** The same test issued several requests. The first three had similarity ≈ 1.0; the fourth was 0.9933; the fifth (last) fell to 0.6675. The model text still correctly described a repeating robotic "test"; the Whisper transcript started similarly then drifted into garbage (`hutch test` … `a turn, the sot, sadi of dash kaya...`). This log does not by itself prove whether later-request audio quality degraded, Whisper hallucinated, or both; the wav was not inspected here. Closed #6047 used the same assertion message on a MiniCPM-o test, not this Qwen3-Omni node. **Error log excerpt:** ```text The first three requests had similarity ≈ 1.0; the fourth was 0.9933. The fifth (last) request: similarity 0.6675 < 0.8 E AssertionError: The audio content is not same as the text FAILED tests/e2e/online_serving/test_qwen3_omni_expansion.py::test_text_audio_to_text_audio_002[batch_token_2048] ``` ### Before submitting a new issue... - [x] Make sure you already searched for relevant issues, and asked the chatbot living at the bottom right corner of the [documentation page](https://vllm-omni.readthedocs.io), which can answer lots of frequently asked questions.
